Use case: illustration-story. New wordless comic panel: time to go home after a wonderful birthday. Image 1 is canonical spaceman Odette; image 2 canonical Aurora; image 3 canonical Eclipse. Image 4 is continuity reference for the princess castle, space uniforms and the two planet friends ONLY. Use the ORIGINAL portraits 1-3 as the authority for faces, hair and proportions, not the imperfect faces in scene 4.
Odette: brown swept hair lavender clip, BLUE eyes, yellow cat-ear helmet yellow bow pink/mint inner ears clear visor, yellow suit white belly pink bow gem yellow gloves boots. Aurora: original PINK swept sculpted hair, broad pale pink face, enormous purple eyes, gold star forehead with white filigree, no braids. Eclipse: pale lavender broad rounded face, purple eyes, pointed silver-lilac central curl, dark sparkling angular hairline and silver side locks. Aurora and Eclipse wear the same yellow space uniform and clear cat-ear helmets as Odette, no crowns over the helmets, no dresses. Preserve small rounded fairy proportions with heads about 60% and short torsos and legs about 40% of their full height excluding helmet ears. No long humanlike bodies. Each has TWO pink-and-white cylindrical ROCKETS strapped ON THEIR BACK, behind the shoulders and torso, no rocket in hand or on chest.
Same beautiful polished dimensional children's animation rendering as the project. Full-bleed wide landscape 1672x941. No text, letters, dialogue, labels or watermark.
Outside the glowing pink, lilac and gold princess castle in reference 4, wide cinematic shot showing the golden star doors on the RIGHT and a sparkling rainbow-edged terrace opening onto the starry sky on the LEFT. Odette, Aurora and Eclipse stand together left-centre with their backs partly angled toward us so we can see the correctly mounted rocket packs; turn their heads enough to clearly recognise their faces. All THREE smile warmly and raise a gloved hand to wave goodbye toward their two planet friends on the right at the castle door. On the right Kirby (pink round body, tiny arms, blue oval eyes, red feet) and the same turquoise upright long-eared friend wave back happily. Turquoise friend must match reference 4: upright small body, huge long drooping turquoise ears with CORAL interiors, blue oval eyes, long thick turquoise tail, NOT a four-legged animal. Five characters total, one of each, no duplicates. Their farewell is affectionate and cheerful. Keep all faces unobscured. Starry purple-blue sky, gentle gold light from castle, a few fading party streamers at the doorway. Their backpacks are ready but not yet firing. No new plot events.

Odette leads at centre-right with Aurora and Eclipse slightly behind at centre-left in a staggered diagonal formation.
